terms.gloss: all along, right from the beginning
terms.comment: Traupman’s phrase, of classical words; not found as a phrase in Lewis & Short or the Latinitas loci collections, so Traupman is the only evidence.

sources: Lewis & Short: usque · Lewis & Short: initium
